title: Local digest run registers observeForever observers that are never removed
reasoning: observeForever is not lifecycle-bound. Every local Run Digest action adds a permanent observer that captures the ViewModel and continues receiving WorkManager updates until explicitly removed. Repeated runs can duplicate completion/failure handling, and old ViewModels can be retained after the settings screen is destroyed.
reproduction: Run a local digest twice from settings, then complete the immediate WorkManager work. Both observeForever callbacks remain registered and can update state for later immediate work events.
recommendation: Observe WorkManager from the UI with lifecycle ownership, or store the Observer and call removeObserver after a terminal state and in onCleared. Prefer converting the LiveData to a Flow collected in viewModelScope if that matches the app's coroutine style.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no SettingsViewModel tests, and no test asserts observer cleanup or repeated local digest runs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a fake DigestScheduler exposing controllable LiveData, call runDigestNow twice in local mode, emit a terminal WorkInfo, and assert only the active run updates state and the observer count returns to zero after completion/onCleared.
